title: Journey
description: One field trip of Bela Bartok, produced by geo/derive-journeys.mjs as specified in docs/JOURNEY-SPEC.md. Primary source: the curated trip index of bartok-gyujtesek.zti.hu (derivedFrom gyuj-collections, id gyuj-<collection id>, label verbatim); fallback: runs of dated records with no collection (derivedFrom date-gap, id J-YYYY-MM-nn). journeys.json is { _meta, journeys: Journey[] } sorted by dateStart then id. Nothing is asserted beyond what the index and the record dates support; every inferred value carries a confidence.

id.description: gyuj-<collection id> for index entries (stable, the site's own id). J-YYYY-MM-nn for date-gap trips: year and month of the first record, nn = 01-based sequence within that month; MM = 00 for year-only clusters.

kind.description: route = every record has a full date, stops are ordered in time and drawn as a polyline. cluster = only year or year+month known; stops are unordered and drawn as a cluster hull, no polyline.

collector.description: Collector name as printed on the records (normalised, e.g. 'Bartok Bela').

dateStart.description: ISO date, month or year of the first record.

dateEnd.description: ISO date, month or year of the last record.

dateConfidence.description: Coarsest precision among the label's periods (phrase = 'Beginning of' / 'Middle of' / 'End of' / 'After', a 10-day window), or, for date-gap trips, the precision shared by its records.

days.description: Inclusive length in days when both ends are day-precise; null otherwise.

confidence.description: 'assumed' means the configured default (Budapest, Bartok's home base) was used; the UI labels it as such.

seq.description: 1-based order along the route; for clusters the order is alphabetical by village and carries no temporal meaning.

placeId.description: location.placeId of the records, when resolved.

kmFromPrevious.description: Great-circle distance from the previous stop (or from the departure point for seq 1); null for clusters or when coordinates are missing.

locationConfidence.description: resolved: coordinates from the record; label: locality from the index label resolved through the gazetteer; label-region: a region or county centre from the built-in table (draw as a cluster, never as a route); unresolved: no coordinates, listed but not drawn.

distanceKm.description: Sum of kmFromPrevious over resolved stops for route trips (departure -> first stop -> ... -> last); null for clusters and for trips without records.

recordCount.description: Attached records; 0 for index entries whose melodies are not online (recordsOnline false) or not yet scraped.

villages.description: Distinct resolved villages (stops with a placeId or village name).

countiesHistorical.description: Distinct historical counties as printed, sorted.

performers.description: Distinct performer names (null names not counted).

songIds.description: All record ids in the trip, sorted.

gapDays.description: Configured maximum gap between consecutive dated records within one trip (default 10).

jumpKm.description: Configured maximum distance between stops on consecutive days before a split (default 250).

splitReasons.description: 'collection' for index entries; for date-gap trips: 'start' first trip, 'gap' > gapDays, 'jump' > jumpKm on consecutive days, 'precision' month-only cluster, 'year' year-only cluster.

byMembership.description: Records attached through their collection id (journey.collectionId, gyuj alternate id/url, record url/id).

byDateCounty.description: Records (rfm volumes) attached because exactly one index entry overlaps their month and names their county/region; the umbrella entry wins when several do.

derivedFrom.description: gyuj-collections: an entry of the trip index on bartok-gyujtesek.zti.hu with its records attached. date-gap: derived from dated records that belong to no index entry.

label.description: The index entry's label verbatim, e.g. 'July-August, 1909. Upper region of the river Fekete-Koros'. Null for date-gap trips.

labelDateRaw.description: Date part of the label as printed.

labelPlaceRaw.description: Place part of the label as printed.

countOnline.description: Record count printed in parentheses on the index; null when the site prints none (no records online).

recordsOnline.description: False for index entries without a count: the trip is documented but its melodies are not online. Such trips have recordCount 0 and stops taken from the label.

uncertain.description: The label carries a question mark.

datePeriods.description: One or more dated periods from the label ('End of March - Beginning of April, November 5-6, 1910' gives two). dateStart/dateEnd span all of them.

recordDateRange.description: Earliest and latest record date actually attached; null when no records.

nowIn.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 of the present-day countries of the stops, sorted.

romanianMaterial.description: Whether the trip collected Romanian material: documented (matches the collecting chronology in Rumanian Folk Music, Suchoff ed.), inferred (Romanian-speaking area, not checked entry by entry), unknown (present-day Romania but language not checked). Null for date-gap trips.
